headline: About Me
subheadline: Product engineer building production-grade AI systems.
bio: I'm Aswin AK, a product engineer specializing in RAG pipelines, Agentic AI systems, and LLM orchestration. I'm a Microsoft-certified Azure AI Engineer (AI-102) and have experience building end-to-end AI applications that handle millions of documents in production.
I enjoy working at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and practical software engineering — taking ideas from proof-of-concept to scalable production deployments.
